name: 06705 · Waterbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06705 (Waterbury) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06705 (Waterbury) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06705 (Waterbury) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
